title: Empty state shows the standard no-data message when no parts match the filters
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Type a nonsense string (for example 'zzqx-no-such-part') into the toolbar search so no part matches.
2. Read the message shown in the data area.
custom_expected:
1. The server returns zero rows and the table shows the empty state.
2. The empty-state label reads exactly: "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" (the application's standard reports no-data label).
